name: followup.note
description: Gate a post-interview thank-you or follow-up before sending: specific to the conversation, one next step, no pitch, no new claims, right length.

specific_reference.instructions: It references something specific that was said in the conversation

one_next_step.instructions: It proposes or asks for exactly one next step

new_pitch.instructions: It introduces new selling points, services, or claims not discussed in the interview

rules.reason: no new pitch in a thank-you

notes: Created 2026-09-18 for Project Get a Job. Advisory until labelled.
